title: Fine-Tuning GPT-4o mini for Nuclear Reactor License Text
summary: Rob Whelan on fine-tuning GPT-4o mini to write nuclear reactor license application text.
learn: License applications need technical data in the right places and a dry, regulator-expected tone.
When a model must speak in a particular format or style, fine-tuning is the way to go.
The proof of concept used 10,000 paragraph examples from previously submitted public licenses.
The fine-tuned model picked up more key facts and the right tone than GPT-4o out of the box.
It hallucinated every figure reference and some values, and tables were still messy.
